title: Origins
description: The origins archive in the assembled config: a curated array of early-development entries that keep their id, sorted by order ascending, then id. Each entry definition also describes its source file (config/origins/<id>.json). Cross-record rules (unique ids, orders and repositories, relatedProjects, asset folders) are enforced by scripts/validate.mjs.

repository.description: A public GitHub repository under the configured username.

role.description: What this repository is within the entry, e.g. Server or Client.

entry.description: One curated early-development milestone. No destination, presentation or deployment fields.

order.description: Curated presentation order (ascending). Unique across the archive.
